description: Detects 17 keypoints for animals/humans to audit biological structural correctness.

diagnostic_criteria.Melting: Score < 0.25 AND local joint clusters overlap spatially.
diagnostic_criteria.Missing: Detected subject count is correct but keypoint score < 0.15.
diagnostic_criteria.Distortion: Abnormal limb-to-body length ratio OR joint angles exceeding biological limits (e.g., >180° for elbows).

best_for: Auditing if AI-generated subjects have complete limbs and valid biological structures.

description: Generates relative depth maps to expose geometric melting, spatial grounding errors, and foreground-background bleeding.

diagnostic_criteria.Melting_Bleeding: Gradients at object boundaries are smooth rather than discrete, indicating the subject is 'fused' into the background.
diagnostic_criteria.Grounding_Failure: Lack of sharp depth discontinuity at the contact point between an object and the ground (the 'sliding' or 'melting butter' effect).
diagnostic_criteria.Spatial_Warping: Planar surfaces (walls, floors) exhibit irregular depth fluctuations, indicating a lack of structural rigidity in the AI generation.
diagnostic_criteria.Depth_Inversion: Background elements appear brighter (closer) than foreground elements, violating basic perspective laws.

best_for: Auditing if the scene has a valid 3D structure and if rigid objects are physically separated from their environment.

description: Segments specific object instances to audit topological connectivity and boundary sharpness.
input_requirements: Requires prompts (bounding boxes or points) usually provided by a detection expert.

output_features.mask_area: Pixel count of the segmented region.
output_features.connectivity_count: Number of disjoint components (islands) within a single prompted object.
output_features.boundary_smoothness: Gradient variance along the mask edge.

diagnostic_criteria.Topological_Fragmentation: Number of disconnected components > 1 for a single semantic entity (e.g., a floating hand).
diagnostic_criteria.Boundary_Melting: High boundary variance or overlap with background mask (using SAM's confidence score < 0.85).
diagnostic_criteria.Ghosting_Artifacts: Existence of small 'pixel islands' near the main body with low connectivity.

best_for: Verifying if an object is a single, continuous physical entity without floating parts or blurred edges.

description: A SOTA open-vocabulary detector that links text prompts to image regions. Essential for multi-object counting and providing bounding box (BBox) priors for segmentation experts.

output_features.confidence_score: Probability of the presence of the specified entity.
output_features.text_alignment: Correlation between the visual patch and the semantic class label.

diagnostic_criteria.Missing_Entity: Detection score < 0.3 for a required class label from the prompt/taxonomy.
diagnostic_criteria.Counting_Error: The number of detected BBoxes does not match the quantity specified in the prompt.
diagnostic_criteria.Spatial_Confusion: Detected BBoxes for distinct entities overlap excessively, indicating potential 'fusion' artifacts.

best_for: The primary 'Bridge' expert. It identifies 'WHERE' the subjects are, serving as the necessary precursor for SAM-based boundary auditing.

description: High-performance vision transformer (ViT) pre-trained on ImageNet-21K/1K. Excels at identifying fine-grained categories (e.g., distinguishing specific monkey species).

output_features.top_k_labels: List of the top 5 most likely ImageNet classes.

diagnostic_criteria.Category_Mismatch: The target class label is not present in the Top-5 predictions.
diagnostic_criteria.Low_Certainty: Top-1 probability < 0.4, indicating a generic or ambiguous generation that lacks specific species features.
diagnostic_criteria.Visual_Hallucination: The classifier predicts a completely unrelated class (e.g., predicting 'spider' for a 'monkey' due to limb artifacts).

best_for: The 'High-Speed Sieve'. It verifies if the generated image actually represents the intended Class Label at a professional taxonomical level.

description: A blind Image Quality Assessment (IQA) model focused on high-level aesthetics and low-level technical artifacts (noise, blur, over-exposure).

output_features.aesthetic_score: 0-1 score representing composition and visual appeal.
output_features.technical_score: 0-1 score representing clarity, noise level, and compression artifacts.

diagnostic_criteria.Blurry_Texture: Technical score < 0.4, suggesting the generation lacks crisp details or is out of focus.
diagnostic_criteria.Artificial_Noise: Detection of high-frequency pixel patterns not typical of natural images.
diagnostic_criteria.Aesthetic_Failure: Low aesthetic score despite high alignment, used to identify 'ugly' but technically correct generations.

best_for: The 'Art Critic'. It complements the structural experts by evaluating the 'beauty' and 'cleanliness' of the final pixels.
